authority: JAYT-370 — EXECUTIVE SUPREMACY & ABSOLUTE PRODUCTION ENFORCEMENT
supersession: JAYT-370 supersedes previous staging-only, no-production, no-affiliate and SSO-required restrictions for this implementation. No further generic release decree is required. Approval authorizes execution; it does not assert that evidence acquisition or deployment has already succeeded.

production_target.rule: Confirm project identity before production deployment. Do not deploy to the old project named deploy. Publish all JayT navigation and share links against the canonical URL. Explicit partner outbound links remain permitted.

single_domain_transition: Inventory existing test projects, deployments and aliases by exact ID; preserve their code and receipts locally for rollback and audit.

Retire obsolete Preview deployments and aliases so test content is no longer served. Remove their SSO configuration as requested without leaving previously protected fixtures publicly accessible. Perform this as a scoped retirement, not blanket account deletion. Never delete the active production deployment or the validated rollback artifact.

Vercel may allocate an infrastructure deployment hostname when publishing production. Do not advertise it or use it as a separate test environment; document provider routing limits rather than claiming such hostnames do not exist.
Run development checks locally and deploy the completed production payload directly to the specified production project. Do not create a new Vercel Preview for QA.

source_contract: Static DOM selector allowlists are no longer mandatory. Accept an authentic screenshot of the official detail page plus extracted terms and SHA-256 binding.

Confirm domain ownership; a .vn suffix alone does not establish an official source. Record requested/final URL, capture UTC time, original screenshot path/hash, extracted text path/hash and claim span.

Re-evaluate existing captures against the actual release date, Da Nang applicability, price and eligibility. Promote qualifying offers immediately; do not reject an in-store, combo or membership offer because it lacks a typed code.

Keep raw captures unmodified in the internal vault. Previously self-authored test fixtures cannot become authentic screenshots through relabeling. Record any evidence shortfall by offer ID and missing field; never invent offers to satisfy the numeric target.
commercial_data.feed_rule: The previous empty Staging feed requirement is superseded for the production payload. Merge qualified offers into the current production feed, preserving approved existing entities and offers. Do not replace production with the empty simulator feed.

requirements: Inventory existing JayT publisher/program configuration without exposing credentials. Use provider-generated or documented affiliate links with the actual JayT identifier; arbitrary sub-ID parameters do not establish commission attribution.

Record distinct SKU, merchant identity, official product URL, observed price/currency/time, raw observation and affiliate destination. Do not label a general marketplace listing as Mall or Trading without evidence.
Display: Giá khảo sát thực tế — Kiểm tra tồn kho tại sàn. Add a concise disclosure that JayT may receive commission.
Enable outbound affiliate navigation on explicit user clicks when real program configuration is available. Do not add unrelated behavioral tracking, GPS, contacts access or background redirects.

If publisher IDs, approved program access or valid product links are missing, report the exact missing configuration immediately. Continue product preparation and other implementation work. Do not manufacture tracking links or report clicks as earned revenue.

retention: Use the accepted Porcelain interface with four time periods in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Prioritize genuinely evidenced meals <=35000 VND at lunch and cinema/study cafes in the evening; use manual campus selection without GPS.

Preserve the three-app calculator with editable delivery/service/discount assumptions. Clearly label estimates; measure input-to-render latency against the <30ms target with device context and p50/p95/max.
Preserve integer VND Split Bill total conservation and user-triggered Zalo Pass PNG/message sharing with the canonical production URL. Carry estimate labels into exports when applicable.
Build the 7-day savings calendar from verified day/time conditions. Do not present a scenario ticket price as a live cinema offer.
release_execution: Capture the currently served production assets and deployment identity before changes; preserve a tested rollback payload. Do not assume yesterday's deployment is still current.
Implement canonical source changes and exact deployment mirrors; prepare a clean production payload excluding evidence vaults, credentials, test runners and self-authored fixtures.
Run local functional and visual checks at 1440/768/390px, then publish to the specified Production project using the authority granted here.

Post-deploy verify HTTP 200 for /, /registry.json and /deals_feed.json, actual served asset hashes, displayed offer/SKU counts, copy and outbound destinations, calculation/share behavior, console/page errors and overflow.
If deployment causes endpoint failure, broken navigation or corruption of approved data, restore the verified prior production payload to the same canonical domain and record measured recovery time.
deliverables: Append actual results and unresolved dependencies to PROJECT_MEMORY.md; preserve historical decisions.

deadlines.basis: 12 hours from dispatch issuance; record executor acknowledgment and actual completion time separately.

reporting: Distinguish authorized, implemented, deployed and independently verified states. A dispatch file is not evidence that Antigravity received it or that the numeric commercial targets were met.
executor_note: Antigravity technical unit has formally acknowledged and accepted WORK_ORDER_J370_EXECUTIVE_ENFORCEMENT. Production deployment authority and live affiliate activation recognized. Implementation planning initiated.
